description: Went up and sat with the tables shut

participation.context: Waited with the cover down, then wrote the three words and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You went up after breakfast and opened the tables on a rubbed leaf. You wrote three words, nine and the rolls and one word, and shut them.

title: Wrote three words for the morning

description: Humphrey's pen across the three rolls

participation.context: Checked the wording at Humphrey's elbow as each roll was marked.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the full closing words and the winter sign onto all three rolls.
participation.name: Humphrey Larkham

story.body: You stood by the trestle as Humphrey Larkham took the shortened tail off York's roll and set the agreed cue and the small winter sign on Gaunt's, York's, and the Queen's.

title: Saw Humphrey mark the three rolls

participation.context: Read the three entrances and did not add a gloss.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw the one word brought into agreement, and the small sign in the corner of each roll.

title: Checked the same cue on three rolls

participation.context: Set the weight and stepped out of the frame.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You let the weight keep the paper flat, and you went on.

title: Left the three rolls under a weight

description: Wrote on a loose leaf beside the tied bundle

participation.context: Wrote the one line, left the bundle knotted, and did not turn the hour into a speech.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: Between coming in and dinner you wrote one line on the tables, that the page you owed was for after the play, and the red bundle stayed knotted. After dinner you came back to the same leaf.

title: Wrote that the other work could wait until after the yard

description: Came up and found the tables shut

participation.context: Wrote the three lines and left the bundle knotted.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You came up with the short candle and wrote three lines on the tables. The bundle stayed its own pile.

title: Wrote three lines on the tables

description: Wrote a separate page from the morning's lines

participation.context: Wrote the page and left the clean leaf still clean.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: On another leaf you wrote that the night stops before she drinks.

title: Wrote the stop before the drink

description: Took a clean leaf apart from the bundle

participation.context: Wrote the page on a loose leaf and did not open the fair copy.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took a clean leaf and rubbed out two false starts. Then you wrote the two lines of the fear, and the call for the Nurse. She has not drunk. You stopped. The red bundle stayed tied, and the leaf stayed apart from it.

title: Wrote the girl alone with the vial

description: The leaf, apart from the bundle

participation.context: Set the leaf down and left the bundle shut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the leaf apart from the bundle, and the knot stayed as it was.

title: Left the leaf apart from the bundle
